detector_fail W starts while EW green active, N already waiting 33s red

counterfactual.change: Removed detector_fail event (events: [] instead of W fail). This restores max_green enforcement and demand-driven phase change, so NS gets green and no approach waits >200s.

explanation: Actuated control with detector_fail on W approach causes EW green to be held indefinitely beyond max_green_seconds (66s). NS has been red since ~603s, so N/S queues grow and wait exceeds 200s. Failure starts at t=636 while EW green is active; controller treats failed detector as no queue for gap-out but also fails to enforce max-green or demand recall, so EW never yields. Removing detector_fail restores normal cycling and no max_wait violation.

violation.detail: approach 0 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: Across steps 801-804 the east-west approaches stay green and keep moving (green dots in E/W) while the north-south approaches are held red with queued vehicles (red dots in N/S). No phase change occurs, so N/S traffic remains blocked for the entire window, leading to excessive red waiting.
